Class WeightSharding

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.parallel.WeightSharding
public final class WeightSharding extends Object
Slices full (unsharded) HuggingFace / Meta weights into the local TP shard.

Linear weights use PyTorch layout [out_features, in_features]. Column-parallel layers take a contiguous out-feature band; row-parallel layers take a contiguous in-feature band.
